patient_id.description: Unique patient identifier in the format P-NNNNN.
patient_id.business_rules: Must match pattern P-\d{5}. Assigned at registration.

test_name.description: Name of the clinical laboratory test performed.

value_labels.Complete Blood Count: CBC panel measuring blood cell counts

test_name.examples: Complete Blood Count, Hemoglobin A1c, Glucose Fasting

result_value.description: Quantitative result of the laboratory test.
result_value.business_rules: Must be a positive decimal. Reference ranges are test-specific.

units.description: Unit of measure for the test result (e.g. mg/dL, mIU/L).

collection_date.description: Date when the specimen was collected from the patient.
collection_date.business_rules: Must be ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Cannot be in the future.

lab_name.description: Name of the laboratory that performed the test.
